$description: Reference catalog of pipeline output anti-patterns that waste Haiku's effort. Surfaced in Haiku summaries and aggregated into sprint results for between-sprint cleanup.

patterns.name: Full log dump on failure
patterns.description: Stage emits entire kubectl/docker describe output or raw tool logs instead of an extracted error summary.
detection_hints: error message buried in the last 10% of output
no explicit 'ERROR' or 'FAIL' prefix near the actual failure

patterns.name: Repetitive progress listing
patterns.description: Thousands of '✓ test-name' lines with no aggregation; takes tokens to reduce to pass/fail counts.
detection_hints: no trailing summary line with counts

patterns.name: Pre-emptive configuration noise
patterns.description: Stage echoes environment vars, tool versions, directory listings before any real work.
detection_hints: > 50 lines before the first real command output
lines matching ENV=, VERSION=, total usage, du -h, etc.

patterns.name: Missing stack trace extraction
patterns.description: On exception, full thread-dump emitted instead of a structured stack-trace block keyed to the failure.
detection_hints: no 'Caused by' or 'at <file>:<line>' structure in summary position
stack text appears multiple times across concurrent threads

patterns.name: Unparseable stage boundaries
patterns.description: Stage start/end markers are free-text or inconsistent across the pipeline; Haiku cannot reliably segment the log.
detection_hints: no consistent '=== Stage X ===' or '[stage:X]' marker
stage names contain spaces or vary between runs

patterns.name: No machine-readable overall result
patterns.description: Pipeline produces no JSON or structured artifact describing overall pass/fail and per-stage outcome — everything must be scraped from the log.
detection_hints: pipeline result only accessible via log grep
patterns.attestation_maps_to: BuildAttestation document as a whole replaces this

patterns.name: Duplicate-error cascade
patterns.description: One root cause triggers many downstream errors all logged verbosely; Haiku must deduplicate.
detection_hints: errors share a common timestamp window
